summary: Currently in AI team and working on creating project specific AI agents
highlights: Agent orchestration: Built and evolved production agent services in Python (FastAPI, LangGraph/LangChain): multi-agent graphs, tools, middleware, and structured plan-then-generate workflows for analytics configuration.

LLM and RAG: Integrated agents with AWS Bedrock (model invocation, prompt caching) and RAG (knowledge-base retrieval and reranking) so generation is grounded in domain metadata rather than free-form text.

Platform integration: Connected agents to a microservice backend via typed HTTP clients, dynamic MCP tools, and remote prompt/guardrail composition; persisted agent workspace artifacts on object storage.

Backend API: Extended ASP.NET Core APIs in sibling services (OpenAPI / NSwag, layered API–business–data) when agents needed new or changed endpoints—contracts, DTOs, and client regeneration across service boundaries.
Test automation: Owned backend test coverage and BDD/E2E automation (Reqnroll/Gherkin, page objects, step definitions) for analytics admin and dashboard flows.
